content.text: An overgrowth of anaerobic bacteria, which replaces the normal lactobacilli of the vagina,
increased pH allows for growth of Gardnerella vaginalis
*in pregnancy, cause of preterm labor & late miscarriage
– exacerbated by menses, intercourse, or douching (introduction of alkaline substances)
thin white discharge that coats the vaginal walls
*BV typically remits spontaneously - current recommendation is to only treat symptomatic patients
amount of normal lactobacilli allows for
DM, obesity, pregnancy, immunocompromised, OCPs, steroids, recent ABX
Thick, adherent “cottage cheese” discharge, no odor
*Recurrences are common;  if frequent, work up diabetes/autoimmune disease
Atrophy of the vaginal epithelium due to diminished estrogen levels
normally converts glucose to lactic acid
vaginal bleeding, breast pain, nausea, VTE
